projects.name: AdventureWorks Enterprise Data Warehouse
projects.summary: In-progress enterprise data warehouse project that transforms AdventureWorks transactional data into an analytics-ready dimensional model with controlled and observable data loads.
projects.problem: Operational data is distributed across normalized transactional structures that are not optimized for historical analysis, consistent business metrics or repeatable analytical workloads.
highlights: Implemented dimensional and staging structures for core business entities
Developed full-load ETL procedures with transaction and error handling
Implemented Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2 for historical product data
Added ETL auditing and execution logging for observable pipeline runs

projects.name: E-Commerce Data Engineering Platform
projects.summary: In-progress data engineering platform with a containerized MySQL operational source that establishes a reproducible foundation for future ingestion and analytical modules.
projects.problem: E-commerce data originates from interdependent operational entities and changes continuously, requiring a reliable source model and repeatable environment before analytical pipelines can be developed safely.
highlights: Implemented a relational OLTP schema for core e-commerce transactions
Containerized the MySQL source database for reproducible development
Added repeatable scripts for database initialization and access provisioning
Loaded documented sample datasets into the operational source
